name: FortiGate
description: Reads a FortiGate's inventory, its firewall policy, its ports and VLANs, and its routing table, so the graph can say which customer is behind which rule.

config.label: FortiGate address
config.hint: Where the REST API answers, for example https://fw1.dc2.example.com. The management address, not a customer-facing one.

config.label: VDOM
config.hint: Which virtual domain to read. Leave as root unless this box is partitioned.

config.label: Verify the certificate
config.hint: Turn this off only for a device using its own self-signed certificate on a management network you control.

config.label: Timeout (seconds)
config.hint: A firewall that is busy must not become an operator staring at a spinner.
